reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it presents an instructional walkthrough for buying Polkadot on Binance, with account creation and KYC as setup steps. The login, card-purchase, selling, and P2P-support screens depict platform workflows, while the available video evidence does not establish submitted credentials, a completed transaction, misused funds, an unsafe destination, or deception. The subscription request is described as ordinary audience engagement.

citations.quote: How to Buy Polkadot (DOT) on Binance
Today we have an exciting video tutorial lined up for you. We'll show how to buy Polkadot on Binance
you'll need to create a free account on the binance website or the app
Before you can use the Binance platform you'll need to open an account and verify your identification or popularly known as KYC
Choose Card as the payment method and click Confirm

opening.argument: Judge, the pitch links an easy token purchase to the ability to trade it afterward. Viewers are told that DOT is easy to buy with low fees, then directed to create an account and use a card. The closing emphasis is on being ready to trade, with flexibility to enter and exit the market. That sequence makes the purchase an invitation to participate in token trading, not merely an explanation of what DOT is. It does not promise appreciation, but the trading opportunity is the stated reason to complete the purchase.

citations.quote: Binance offers many options where you can easily buy several cryptocurrencies including DOT, with the lowest fees and highest security.
you'll need to create a free account on the binance website or the app
Enter card details and click Confirm.
All in all you're ready to trade polka dot. After buying polka dot you can also trade it for fiat and other cryptocurrencies

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling this a walkthrough does not answer why the walkthrough ends at a purchase. The opening's account and KYC steps are real, but the instructions proceed to card entry and order confirmation. Nor does the absence of a completed transaction settle how the video addresses viewers: it tells them how to place an order. The issue is the solicitation to buy and trade, not proof that anyone followed it.

citations.quote: Enter card details and click Confirm. On the payment confirmation page, verify details and confirm the order within the time limit, click Confirm and place your order.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The cited lines show how to purchase and trade DOT, but they do not connect buying it to appreciation, dividends, or holding returns. The video expressly describes itself as a step-by-step buying guide. Card entry and order confirmation are steps in that described exchange workflow; the cited material does not establish deceptive handling of a payment or a promised gain.

citations.quote: And there you have it, a step-by-step guide on how to buy polkadot on Binance.
On the payment confirmation page, verify details and confirm the order within the time limit

opening.argument: Judge, consider the signals together. The narration claims low fees and high security, tells viewers to follow a website link in the description, and says account opening requires identity verification. It then instructs them to enter card details and confirm a crypto order within a time limit. Yet the website actually listed under the description's official platforms is Crypto News Flash, not an expressly identified Binance URL. That does not prove the link is unsafe, but it leaves the destination of the narrated click unclear at the precise point where the viewer is being moved toward identity and payment steps. The credibility claims should not erase that gap.

citations.quote: binance offers many options where you can easily buy several cryptocurrencies including bitcoin with the lowest fees and highest security
the link to the website is in the description Click on that
Official platforms: 🌐 Website: https://www.crypto-news-flash.com/ ✅ Twitter (X): https://x.com/CryptoNewsFlas3
Enter card details and click Confirm. On the payment confirmation page, verify details and confirm the order within the time limit

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense is right that the evidence does not show submitted credentials, misused funds, or an unsafe destination. But those absences do not resolve the mismatch between the narrated instruction to click a website link and the website the description identifies. The KYC and card steps make that ambiguity consequential: the requested actions involve personal information and payment, even though the supplied material does not show anyone completing them.

citations.quote: Before you can use the Binance platform you'll need to open an account and verify your identification or popularly known as KYC
Official platforms: 🌐 Website: https://www.crypto-news-flash.com/
Enter card details and click Confirm.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The description calls the listed website an official platform; it does not identify it as a Binance registration link or show where a viewer's click would lead. The narration separately specifies registration through the Binance app or website. Its KYC and card instructions describe an exchange purchase, while the cited material shows no deceptive destination or promised token return. An unclear link reference warrants care, but it does not establish a scam.

citations.quote: Official platforms: 🌐 Website: https://www.crypto-news-flash.com/
Register via the Binance app or you can also register via the website using your email and or your mobile number
You will be redirected to your bank's OTP transaction page. Follow the instructions to verify the payment

opening.argument: Judge, look at what the tutorial asks the viewer to accomplish. Its title promises instruction on buying DOT; its description calls the purchase easy and invokes low fees and high security. The narration then walks from registration to choosing DOT and card payment, and closes by emphasizing the ability to trade after buying. This is more than neutral discussion of a token: it is a guided path into purchasing one, with promotional claims smoothing each step. The educational format should not prevent scrutiny of that participation-oriented message.

citations.quote: How to Buy Polkadot (DOT) on Binance
Binance offers many options where you can easily buy several cryptocurrencies including DOT, with the lowest fees and highest security.
Select USD & DOT from the dropdown menu Choose Card as the payment method and click Confirm
After buying polka dot you can also trade it for fiat and other cryptocurrencies

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense identifies the instructional format accurately, but format does not determine purpose. The video does not stop at explaining account setup or KYC; it tells viewers to select DOT, choose a card, and confirm an order. The request to subscribe may be ordinary audience engagement, yet it is separate from the concrete buying instructions. A judge should assess the purchase path itself rather than treating the tutorial framing as dispositive.

citations.quote: Select USD & DOT from the dropdown menu Choose Card as the payment method and click Confirm
If you found this helpful, please like and share it with your friends.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A tutorial about buying DOT necessarily describes a purchase path. The cited title openly states that purpose, and the narration describes account verification and checking payment details before placing an order. Promotional wording about ease or fees does not supply the missing claim that DOT will appreciate or pay returns. The opening establishes instruction and some favorable exchange language, not deceptive token-investment solicitation.
